summary: Iter10 — NRA filing exports (PAYE CSV, NASSIT CSV, mark-filed), enriched compliance summary, tenant isolation, PWA icons, and Recharts no-regression all verified. Backend pytest: 13/13 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_nra_filing.py. Frontend Playwright (Gov + Demo): compliance-page renders with 4 KPIs, PAYE bands, per-period export/mark-filed actions for Gov; Demo sees only legacy export-{rid}. Mark-filed flow round-trip works: dialog confirm -> button disappears -> Filed pill renders. PWA icons live (icon-192.png=3213B image/png, icon-512.png=9097B image/png, both PNG magic bytes verified). Manifest icons array intact, theme_color=#133326 set in <meta name='theme-color'>.

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warning still fires (Recharts 3.6 + React 19 strict-mode race). Confirmed cosmetic — charts render correctly. Documented as won't-fix per handoff.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/compliance.py — NRA PAYE CSV correctly computes Sierra Leone taxable = gross - nassit_employee (line 102), matching NRA convention. NASSIT 5%/10% labels in CSV columns (employee_5pct/employer_10pct/total_15pct) match the statutory rates from payroll_engine constants.

/file-nra/{rid} idempotency is correct: existence check on (run_id, tenant_filter) before insert returns 409 (line 187-189). Audit log entry action='nra_filed' written after insert. NRA reference format NRA-{period}-{first8 of run id} is deterministic and human-readable.

Tenant isolation: db.nra_filings uses tf=tenant_filter(user) for BOTH find_one duplicate check AND insert (line 187, 192). /filings list endpoint filters by tenant_filter (line 212). Verified end-to-end — Demo and Gov filings lists are disjoint and only contain their own runs.

Compliance summary outstanding[] is derived from history filter — DRY, single source of truth. filed_count comes from filings collection len, not from history filter — keeps the two views consistent even if a payroll run is later deleted (filing record persists).

Compliance.jsx — uses useFeatures().has('nra_export') to gate Gov-tier UI; falls back to legacy /nra-export/{rid} JSON->CSV for non-Gov tenants. window.confirm dialog before mark-filed gives audit-safe UX. busy state prevents double-download. All interactive elements have data-testid (export-nra-paye-{rid}, export-nassit-{rid}, mark-filed-{rid}, export-{rid} for legacy).

PWA icons (3213B + 9097B PNGs) are now real files on disk under /app/frontend/public — served by react-scripts dev server as image/png. Manifest references match exactly. theme-color meta tag correct.
